local grassList = {}

local Grass = {} do
	Grass.__index = Grass

	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	function Grass:Rotate(x, y, z)
		TweenService:Create(
			self.Part,
			TweenInfo.new(.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine),
			{Orientation = Vector3.new(x, y, z)}
		):Play()
	end

	function Grass.new(part)
		local grass = {}
		grass.Position = part.Position
		grass.LookVector = part.CFrame.LookVector
		grass.XVector = part.CFrame.XVector
		grass.Part = part
		grass.Bone1 = part:FindFirstChild("Bone")

		table.insert(grassList, grass)
		return setmetatable(grass, Grass)
	end
end

local currentPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local currentCharacter
local currentRoot

currentPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	currentCharacter = character
	currentRoot = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
end)

currentPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
	currentCharacter = nil
	currentRoot = nil
end)

currentPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()

wait(1)

for _, grassObject in ipairs(workspace.Foliage:GetChildren()) do
	Grass.new(grassObject)
end

game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:Connect(function()
	if not currentRoot then return end
	for _, grass in ipairs(grassList) do
		local distance = currentPlayer:DistanceFromCharacter(grass.Position)
		if distance < 7 then
			if distance < 6 then
				if (currentRoot.Position - grass.Position).Unit:Dot(grass.LookVector) < -.5 then
					grass:Rotate(-20, 0, 0) --if I stand left
				end
				if (currentRoot.Position - grass.Position).Unit:Dot(grass.LookVector) > .5 then
					grass:Rotate(20, 0, 0) --if I stand right
				end
				if (currentRoot.Position - grass.Position).Unit:Dot(grass.XVector) < .5 and (currentRoot.Position - grass.Position).Unit:Dot(grass.LookVector) < .5 and (currentRoot.Position - grass.Position).Unit:Dot(grass.LookVector) > -.5  then
					grass:Rotate(0, 0, -30) --if I stand Back
				end
				if (currentRoot.Position - grass.Position).Unit:Dot(grass.XVector) > .5 and (currentRoot.Position - grass.Position).Unit:Dot(grass.LookVector) < .5 and (currentRoot.Position - grass.Position).Unit:Dot(grass.LookVector) > -.5  then
					grass:Rotate(0, 0, 30) --if I stand Front
				end
			else
				grass:Rotate(0,0,0)
			end
		end
	end
end)
